name: Atlas: the whole chemical wiring of the worm

meta.author: spike
meta.source: C. elegans hermaphrodite connectome, Cook SJ et al. 2019, Nature 571:63-71, doi:10.1038/s41586-019-1352-7, read through OpenWorm cect 0.3.5; the data keep the terms of the original publication; extraction: tools/connectome/worm_table.py; data/connectome/worm/PROVENANCE.md
meta.notes: the chemical graph of whole.json (every directed pair with its synapse count, stored as the weight magnitude in pA; self-connections kept; electrical couplings not included); the four groups are the cell-type blocks (category of the data set) and have nothing free; no stimulus: the level reads the wiring; generated by circuits/tools/gen_atlas_worm.py
